verdict.rationale: Fivetran's core product runs data pipelines fully autonomously: connectors auto-sync on schedules (as fast as 1-minute syncs), transformations auto-execute after syncs or on a schedule, and Hybrid Deployment Agents can be configured to auto-start after reboot and run persistently in the background managing multiple connections without manual intervention. This directly matches 'automations that run autonomously in the background.' Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration specifically of long-term autonomous reliability (community notes occasional sync drift requiring manual re-sync), and no evidence this is framed/marketed specifically as an 'AI-native' agentic automation feature beyond standard ETL scheduling.
